content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Housekeeping Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Educational qualification: The notice says: "No educational qualification required." For the full eligibility details of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection depends on how you perform in the interview. Under the interview details, the notice gives the mode as offline, at the E&ICT Academy, Technology Complex, IIT Guwahati. The same notice also says shortlisted candidates will get the online link for the interview by email. Check your email and the application portal for your status. No TA/DA is paid for attending the test or interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Nature of post: project staff, hired on an ad hoc basis under Project No. CET-P-E&ICT-HOA-01-GIA3&4 Duration of appointment: 11 months HRA: No Medical facility: No

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Guwahati Housekeeping Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the Recruitment Portal of the Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati . Search for the project title "Financial Assistance for setting up Electronics & ICT Academies" to find the Housekeeping position. Follow the instructions and guidelines given on the portal, then submit your application by 6 November 2026, 05:30 PM. Check your email and the portal for your shortlisting status and the interview details. For technical help with the online application, email [email protected] . For other questions, contact the Principal Investigator, Prof. Gaurav Trivedi, at [email protected] or +91-361-2582536 (O).

faq.question: Q1. Do I need any educational qualification for the IIT Guwahati Housekeeping post?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no educational qualification is required for this post.

faq.question: Q2. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment lasts 11 months. It is a project post under Project No. CET-P-E&ICT-HOA-01-GIA3&4.

faq.question: Q3. Does the post include HRA or medical benefits?
faq.answer: No. The pay is Rs. 7500, and the post has no HRA and no medical facility.

faq.question: Q4. How do I find this post on the portal?
faq.answer: Search for the project title "Financial Assistance for setting up Electronics & ICT Academies" on the R&D Cell recruitment portal.

faq.question: Q5. When and where is the interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 11 November 2026 at 11.00 am at the E&ICT Academy, Technology Complex, IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q6. Will I be paid travel costs to attend the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the test or interview.

faq.question: Q7. Whom do I contact if the online form gives problems?
faq.answer: Email [email protected] for technical help with the online application.

faq.question: Q8. Who is the Principal Investigator of the project?
faq.answer: Prof. Gaurav Trivedi of the Department of Electronics and Electrical Engineering. You can reach him at [email protected] or +91-361-2582536 (O).
